notes.title: New Season - Aug 21, 2025
notes.content: [p]We'd like to thank all players for their feedback, which contributed to our improvements. We also apologize to those who had a less-than-ideal experience with the game's launch. We understand that we need to continually improve and listen to the community! However, we're implementing many improvements and new features, and of course, a new season with plenty of new content for you all![/p][p][/p][h3][b]DAWNLIGHT new season pass is live now!  [/b]  [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/f75d8c4cf7fcc0c0706407a3fc35d2b7aa6f9cc2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Design Improvement;  [/p][/*][*][p]UI Improvement;  [/p][/*][*][p]Skill Balance;[/p][/*][*][p]Improve Loot Drops;[/p][/*][*][p]Improve XP;[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Combat;[/p][/*][*][p]Removed combat countdown;[/p][/*][*][p]Minor bug fixes!  [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/23ecd48e4f890a5bcfbdde033d408d0b92f1d3bd.png"][/img][/p][h3]In the guild you can change heroes while maintaining the same level and resetting their skills;[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/8a9c9acef547ef87d9e2ba5133706749f61ae0cb.png"][/img][/p][h3]A new divine forge that can be used to enhance your legendary items and add additional properties;[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/82c8b3416d1756f5fe328fcdbf4da4d72c1aefa8.png"][/img][/p][h3]New epic quests, monsters, bosses and maps;[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/ca08e17f7be5d0c10ac2f6a961457f97edbb753d.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/0cc70152ead2eab6dd2320b43613ffe2ad3d22f7.png"][/img][/p][h3]Players have access to the black market where they can obtain heroic and legendary materials;[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45602533/f0c92a73dbde12eb2b6d8f1e55dccd5eba2859bb.png"][/img][/p][p]Would like to thank everyone for their feedback and I hope you like the improvement!  This is a live update. Please exit the game and update your client (restart your Steam client if you're not seeing the update). We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]If you liked the game, contribute with a positive review to help spread the word even further for the growth of the community.[/b][/p]
